definitions.atomic_lock_target_touches: Per iteration, add one at both endpoints of every constraint, including zero-weight endpoints. Intended pair-level lock targets, not actual attempts/retries/waits/collisions.
definitions.cv: Population standard deviation divided by mean; null for empty or all-zero groups.
definitions.positive_weight_endpoint_updates: Per iteration, add one at u/v only when the corresponding f64 weight is positive. Semantic eligibility for an update, not a hardware memory-store count.
definitions.top_1pct: Largest ceil(group vertex count / 100) loads; share uses that group's total.
definitions.whole_run: Per-iteration counts can be multiplied by iterations; no SGD trajectory or timing is simulated.
